cells.gaps: No report, review or evaluation against the 2024-2029 plan's own targets has been found: the two joint sector reviews (RWA-014, RWA-019) report against the 2018-2024 plan it replaced. No source ties a domestic budget line to the plan, and the costing (RWA-004) is read from the contents list only, with no figures.
cells.note: ICT Sector Strategic Plan 2024-2029: adopted, public on the ministry's site and running to 2029, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs a published report of results against this plan, and the only results held are against its predecessor.
